page: Microsoft Azure M64s_v2 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MSMediumMemoryv2 family. Built on the x86_64 architecture and deployed through the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the server is powered by dedicated Intel processors. It provides 64 dedicated vCPUs coupled with 1024.0 GB of system memory, establishing an extensive memory allocation of 16.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The configuration provides no onboard local disk storage and contains no discrete GPU hardware accelerators. Persistent data handling requires network-attached storage infrastructure, with the instance providing support for Premium Storage tiers. Additionally, the instance does not provision complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default.

The substantial memory-to-vCPU ratio makes the M64s_v2 cost-effective specifically for large datasets requiring residence in main memory rather than high disk IOPS from local scratch volumes or parallel processing on graphics hardware. This resource balance fits enterprise in-memory databases, large-scale caching implementations, memory-heavy enterprise resource planning systems, and real-time data processing engines.
description: Microsoft Azure M64s_v2 is a memory-optimized virtual machine within the MSMediumMemoryv2 family, powered by dedicated Intel x86_64 processors managed through Microsoft Hyper-V. The system features 64 dedicated vCPUs and 1024.0 GB of RAM, resulting in an allocation of 16.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes no GPU acceleration and does not bundle local disk storage, operating instead with external Premium Storage attachments. The high density of memory relative to vCPUs provides an architectural profile suited for environments where system memory capacity is the primary operational constraint. Consequently, M64s_v2 is tailored for memory-intensive workloads, including large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise data caching systems, in-memory analytics engines, and heavy transactional database platforms requiring vast RAM capacities.
